snippet.title: Friday Night Funkin' - Double Kill but 4 Impostors and 5 Crewmates join in
snippet.description:
new discord server!!!: https://discord.gg/CGrVnjyq9h

another crewmate and impostor is here YAY!!!!!

anyways credit to @doggirlpaws2  for the flp yeah go get it here
www.youtube.com/watch?v=FSl3jc7uu30

Will be available with JS Engine v1.4.0: https://github.com/JordanSantiagoYT/FNF-PsychEngine-NoBotplayLag/releases/latest

DOWNLOAD VS IMPOSTOR V5: https://gamejolt.com/games/vsimpostor/643430

OG Double Kill Cast

Black Impostor - What do you think?
White Impostor - ditto
BF - Crewmate

Added Cast (BF’s side)

Pink - Impostor (but a pacifist one?)
Yellow - Crewmate
GF - Crewmate?
Player - Crewmate
Jorsawee - Crewmate

Added Cast (Opponent Side)

Gray - Crewmate (but black corrupted him and he's black's adoptive son so he gets a pass)
Red - Impostor (but that should be obvious by his gun)
Maroon - Impostor (also white's boyfriend)
Red Mungus - Impostor

the colored note designs were taken from darkness takeover!: https://gamebanana.com/mods/393266

subscribe to second channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ogaitnaSnadroJ

Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT5W7RagAUqZAjYE141Dscw/join

Welcome to Jordan Santiago!

Gameplay, Video Edits, and more!
Favorite games: PK XD, Roblox, Peggle, Minion Rush, Friday Night Funkin'!
lol expected there to be more? No lol!
